cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(test_ksyntax_highlighting LANGUAGES CXX)

# Find the Qt5 components (aggregated Qt5Config regenerated by CMakeDeps)
# and the installed KF5SyntaxHighlighting cmake package.
find_package(Qt5 CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui)
find_package(KF5SyntaxHighlighting CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(test_ksyntax_highlighting test_ksyntax_highlighting.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_ksyntax_highlighting PRIVATE
    Qt5::Core Qt5::Gui KF5::SyntaxHighlighting)

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME test_ksyntax_highlighting COMMAND test_ksyntax_highlighting)
